source_rule: Candidate implementation frozen before guard-initial; any subsequent runtime change gets a new explicit role and fresh matched repeats. No slower repeat discarded.
diagnostics: guard-diagnostic is separate trace-on process after performance collection; no diagnostic sample enters timing aggregates
comparison: Keep per-stage results plus pooled all-six-repeat metrics per role; distinguish within-stage from between-stage variation. No statistical significance claim from three repeats per stage.
